subject: Notice: Subprocessor rotation (TelemetryFlow) — contract & evidence request
messages:
From: EdgeWave Ops <ops@edgewave-analytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: onboarding TelemetryFlow as a telemetry subprocessor (effective 2026-09-01)

Hi Alex —

Per our vendor lifecycle process I wanted to notify Redwood Inference that EdgeWave will begin routing telemetry collection for a subset of customers to TelemetryFlow (TelemetryFlow, Inc.) starting 2026-09-01. This change affects only aggregated telemetry and anonymized request metrics; no customer PII or prompt/content payloads will be shared.

Summary: 
- New subprocessor: TelemetryFlow, Inc. (logs + telemetry ingestion; retention = 30 days)
- Purpose: scalable metrics ingestion and real-time anomaly detection for platform health
- Data classes: anonymized request metadata, tpm/cpm, connection timing, stack traces (no raw request body)
- Transfer jurisdictions: US (primary), fallback UK (limited) — TelemetryFlow does not persist data outside these locations for Redwood customers
- Security controls: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, SOC 2 Type II in place (report on request)

Attachments: edgewave_subprocessor_notice_20260817.pdf (notice), telemetryflow_processor_profile.pdf (vendor profile), subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (updated roster snapshot)

We documented the technical flow and have a short Q&A below. If you need contract addendum language, we can provide a standard DPA amendment and SOC 2 artifact. Please let us know if you require additional evidence (encryption keys, onshore routing diagrams, or a quick design review).

Best,
Jaya Patel
Operations Lead — EdgeWave Analytics
ops@edgewave-analytics.com

-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: EdgeWave Ops <ops@edgewave-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: onboarding TelemetryFlow as a telemetry subprocessor (effective 2026-09-01)

Thanks Jaya — quick acknowledgement and a few clarifying asks so we can route to Legal/Trust: 

1) Can you confirm TelemetryFlow will never receive customer content or request bodies (only anonymized metadata)? Please be explicit about any edge cases (debug snapshots, sampling).
2) Please provide the export-country list and whether TelemetryFlow uses any downstream SaaS processors (e.g. cloud storage providers).
3) We will need the SOC 2 Type II report and the DPA addendum draft (or a link to the DocuSign template).
4) What is the onshore fallback behavior if US capacity is impacted? Are metrics queued or redirected to UK?

If you can get the answers and artifacts by EOD Wed (2026-08-19) that helps our compliance sprint.

I will loop in Kimberly for contract alignment. Laura — can you update our internal roster and flag any customers in regulated verticals?

— Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Jaya Patel <jaya.patel@edgewave-analytics.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: onboarding TelemetryFlow as a telemetry subprocessor (effective 2026-09-01)

Hi Alex — answers below inline: 

1) TelemetryFlow will receive only anonymized metadata. Debug snapshots are sampled and scrubbed; we have a policy that removes any detected prompt/content strings before forwarding. We will share the sampling policy and an example scrubbed snapshot.

2) Export countries: primary US, secondary UK (redundancy). TelemetryFlow uses CloudBloc (US) for short-term ingest queueing and ArchiveStore (UK) for long-tail storage; both are covered under their SOC 2. No cross-border transfers beyond US/UK.

3) SOC 2 Type II report: available upon NDA — link: https://edgewave-secure-files.example/soc2-telemetryflow (we can upload to your secure intake). DPA addendum: draft DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/edgewave-telemetryflow-addendum

4) Onshore fallback: if US region is degraded telemetry will failover to UK endpoint; data is queued and deduplicated. TelemetryFlow retains only hashed identifiers and drops any payload flagged as customer content.

Attachments: telemetryflow_processor_profile.pdf (security profile), subprocessor_roster_v2.csv (roster)

Let me know if you want a quick 30-min call with TelemetryFlow's security engineer.

Regards,
Jaya
Operations Lead — EdgeWave Analytics

-----
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWave Ops <ops@edgewave-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Notice: onboarding TelemetryFlow as a telemetry subprocessor (effective 2026-09-01)

Kimberly — forwarding for Legal review. Highlights: TelemetryFlow will only receive anonymized telemetry (per vendor), primary storage US, fallback UK, SOC2 available on request, DPA addendum DocuSign link provided.

Request: Please confirm if our standard DPA amendment language is sufficient or whether we need specific contractual clauses for onshore routing, sampling/scrubbing attestations, or additional audit rights. EdgeWave is asking for confirmation prior to the 2026-09-01 cutover.

Suggested timeline: 3 business days for review; if Legal approves we will route DocuSign back to EdgeWave. If pricing or liability changes are required, loop Procurement.

Thanks — Alex

-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeWave Ops <ops@edgewave-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: onboarding TelemetryFlow as a telemetry subprocessor (effective 2026-09-01)

Thanks for the flag. Quick guidance: 

1) We need the SOC 2 Type II report and the scrubbed debug snapshot example uploaded to our secure intake. We require an attestation that TelemetryFlow will not receive raw request bodies under any normal or fallback scenario.
2) Our standard DPA addendum is likely sufficient but please ensure the addendum explicitly states: no access to customer content, 30-day retention for telemetry, and the exact fallback jurisdictions (US/UK). If EdgeWave's DocuSign draft alters liability or adds retention >30 days, route to Procurement.
3) Add a short audit clause: right to request supporting evidence annually or after a significant incident. Telemetry vendor should provide point-of-contact for security inquiries.

Action items: 
- EdgeWave: upload SOC2 and scrubbed sample to the secure link and confirm no downstream processors beyond CloudBloc/ArchiveStore.
- Alex/Laura: maintain a temporary watchlist for customers in regulated verticals (finance/health) and postpone cutover for those tenants until attestations are received.
- Kimberly: will sign off or request redlines within 3 business days of artifact submission.

Please confirm receipt and estimated delivery for SOC2 and scrubbed sample.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
